name: MLLMKC-Bench-dataset
description: A benchmark dataset intended to evaluate multilingual LLM factual knowledge and knowledge-check capabilities across languages. It contains question–answer items (multiple-choice and open-ended) designed to probe knowledge coverage, consistency, and cross-lingual transfer. Typically used to measure accuracy of multilingual models on factual recall and reasoning over varied knowledge domains.
reputation: A community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face with limited adoption outside its immediate uploader/community.
